popCulture.title: Description of Greece
popCulture.creator: Pausanias
popCulture.description: Pausanias makes Penthilus the bastard son of Orestes by Erigone — the Pelopid who, when the Heracleidae drive the house from the Peloponnese, leads Achaeans to seize Lesbos.

popCulture.title: Penthilus
popCulture.description: Son of Orestes and Erigone — founder of the Penthilid line on Lesbos; carefully distinct from Penthilus son of Periclymenus.

popCulture.title: Lesbos
popCulture.description: The island Penthilus' descendants colonize — the Aeolian bridge from Pelopid exile to the Asian shore.

popCulture.title: Orestes
popCulture.description: Penthilus' father — the avenger whose illegitimate son carries Achaean blood to Lesbos after the Heraclid return.
